snippet.title: A Player Asked for a Giant Bronze Lizard, So I Built It #shorts
snippet.description: A player on the Mad Steez forum asked for a giant bronze lizard in Japow Forest. I read it and built it. Got an idea or found a bug? Post it in the forum and I'll consider it and build it. Play free at madsteez.lol #freeski #skiing #indiegame #shorts
